responsibility: Declares the central context and entry points for Rust HIR type checking. It defines TypeCheckContext, the shared repository for resolved TyTy nodes, builtins, return and loop contexts, trait references, receivers, associated impl/type mappings, autoderef and cast adjustments, operator-overload call sites, variant mappings, predicates, and recursion guards; it also declares TypeCheckContextItem for current function/impl/trait item state and the top-level TypeResolution driver.
same_name_distinction: Acts as the central declaration and state header for this stem, defining TypeCheckContext, TypeCheckContextItem, and the TypeResolution interface; the paired .cc file supplies the crate-walking resolution algorithm and TraitItemReference method implementations.
